items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But Wooty Holmes was the vocalist and the director.

ctx.x: That was the Sammy LePalm Orchestra. Sammy Holmes and his LaPalm Orchestra. Now, that was about five or six pieces. Two brothers played. I know Tommy played

sax, I don't remember if Sammy played sax or trombone. But Wooty Holmes was the vocalist and the director. It was always great to have a director in a band, you know. He'd be standing up there, you know (inaudible). And --
Was Herschel playing tenor then, or --
